parsed.rationale_overall: Both systems deliver well-personalized, risk-aligned recommendations addressing the international/EM question with comparable structure and safety language. System A edges ahead on factual grounding (more accurate VXUS sizing math and avoidance of B's questionable claim that VXUS currently has insufficient allocation when the user's actual VXUS weight isn't specified) and actionability (more concrete dollar amounts tied to the equity base and clearer rebalancing pathway).
